prompt: Create an orthographic stair correction atlas with exactly THREE columns and TWO rows, transparent background. Columns left to right: FRONT, TOP, REAR. Row 1 is the UP arena stone stairs in the first reference; row 2 is the DOWN arena stone stairs in the second reference, retaining each source opposite direction. Preserve warm gray/tan stone blocks, dark mortar and square stone side posts. FRONT: level straight-on riser elevation with vertical stone riser faces as horizontal bands; no diagonal isometric flight. TOP: vertical overhead plan of the stair flight, showing horizontal tread tops, narrow mortar separations, and only small square post-cap footprints at corners; no vertical post faces. REAR: opposite structural backing elevation, plain solid masonry support/back with no forward-facing tread surfaces. Each row-cell has one complete projection centered with generous transparent gutters, no labels or borders, no clipping. No extra blocks, scenery, shadows or perspective.
